OpenAlex.auth_note: Sign in at openalex.org and approve; queries run on your OpenAlex API key and daily budget, no key to paste.
OpenAlex.cli: claude mcp add --transport http openalex https://mcp.openalex.org/mcp
OpenAlex.plan: Free; free OpenAlex account required, usage counts against your daily budget.
OpenAlex.note_en: Hosted by OpenAlex – sign in with a free account; usage counts against your daily OpenAlex budget.
OpenAlex.note_de: Von OpenAlex betrieben – Anmeldung mit kostenlosem Konto; Abfragen zählen gegen Ihr tägliches OpenAlex-Kontingent.

draw.io.transport_note: Docs use "type": "http" / --transport http; streamable HTTP vs SSE not named explicitly.
draw.io.auth_note: Docs: the server needs no sign-in.
draw.io.note_en: Hosted server without sign-in, or run locally via npx; also reads Mermaid and draw.io XML.
draw.io.note_de: Gehosteter Server ohne Anmeldung oder lokal per npx; liest auch Mermaid und draw.io-XML.

Figma.transport_note: Docs use --transport http / "type": "http"; SSE not mentioned.
Figma.auth_note: Browser sign-in with your Figma account on first connect ("Allow access"). Only clients in the Figma MCP catalogue can connect.
Figma.install: Desktop server alternative runs inside the Figma desktop app (no URL documented on the overview page).
Figma.cli: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp
Figma.plan: Rate limits by plan/seat: Starter (View/Collab) up to 20 calls per month; Professional Full/Dev 200/day, 10/min; Organization 200/day, 15/min; Enterprise 600/day, 20/min; Education as Professional. Writing to canvas outside drafts needs a Full seat. Desktop server needs Dev or Full seat on a paid/Education plan.
Figma.note_en: Sign in with your Figma account; only listed clients can connect. Free Starter seats get just 20 calls a month.
Figma.note_de: Anmeldung mit Figma-Konto; nur gelistete Clients. Kostenlose Starter-Plätze erhalten nur 20 Aufrufe pro Monat.

Paper Search MCP.auth_note: No key required; optional free keys raise limits (e.g. PAPER_SEARCH_MCP_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY, PAPER_SEARCH_MCP_CORE_API_KEY); IEEE needs a key to activate.
Paper Search MCP.install: Python 3.10+ and uv (on macOS uvx may need 'brew install coreutils', or use 'uv tool run paper-search-mcp')
Paper Search MCP.note_en: Runs locally via uvx; searches many open sources at once. Free API keys are optional and only raise rate limits.
Paper Search MCP.note_de: Läuft lokal per uvx; durchsucht viele offene Quellen gleichzeitig. Kostenlose API-Schlüssel sind optional und erhöhen nur Limits.

Semantic Scholar.auth_note: Optional API key in header x-api-key for higher rate limits; request a key via the form linked on the Ai2 page.
Semantic Scholar.note_en: Ai2 Asta server on the Semantic Scholar corpus; works without a key, an optional x-api-key raises rate limits.
Semantic Scholar.note_de: Ai2-Asta-Server auf dem Semantic-Scholar-Korpus; funktioniert ohne Schlüssel, ein optionaler x-api-key erhöht die Limits.

Elicit.auth_note: OAuth 2.0 sign-in with your Elicit account.
Elicit.cli: claude mcp add --transport http elicit https://elicit.com/api/mcp
Elicit.note_en: Sign in with your Elicit account via OAuth; requires a Pro, Scale or Enterprise plan.
Elicit.note_de: Anmeldung mit Ihrem Elicit-Konto per OAuth; erfordert einen Pro-, Scale- oder Enterprise-Tarif.

Perplexity.auth_note: OAuth sign-in (admin of a paying API organisation) or header 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>'.
Perplexity.plan: Billed at standard Perplexity API pricing; OAuth requires admin of an API organisation that can pay for usage.
Perplexity.note_en: Hosted with sign-in or API key, or local via npx; every call is billed at Perplexity API prices.
Perplexity.note_de: Gehostet mit Anmeldung oder API-Schlüssel oder lokal per npx; jeder Aufruf wird zu Perplexity-API-Preisen abgerechnet.

Consensus.transport_note: Implied by the troubleshooting entry 'OAuth login is only supported for streamable HTTP servers'; not stated as a field.
Consensus.auth_note: OAuth in most clients; other clients via API key as Bearer token. 'search' works without an account; thread tools need sign-in or key.
Consensus.plan: Consensus plan sets results per search, monthly calls, DOIs/full-text excerpts; no account needed to try search.
Consensus.note_en: Search works without an account; signing in unlocks research threads. Your Consensus plan sets monthly calls and result depth.
Consensus.note_de: Suche funktioniert ohne Konto; die Anmeldung schaltet Recherche-Threads frei. Ihr Consensus-Tarif bestimmt Aufrufe und Ergebnistiefe.

DeepL Write.auth_note: OAuth 2.1 sign-in with your DeepL account; no client ID, secret or API key needed.
DeepL Write.plan: DeepL Free and seat-based plans (Individual, Team, Business, Enterprise); rephrasing/correction (Write) only on seat-based plans that include Write.
DeepL Write.note_en: Hosted server with DeepL sign-in; translation also on Free, rephrasing only on seat-based plans that include Write.
DeepL Write.note_de: Gehosteter Server mit DeepL-Anmeldung; Übersetzen auch im Free-Tarif, Umformulieren nur in Platz-Tarifen mit Write.

Napkin AI.transport_note: Not stated in the docs (only 'remote MCP server').
Napkin AI.auth_note: OAuth 2.0 browser sign-in with your Napkin account; no API token pasted.
Napkin AI.plan: Creating a visual spends Napkin credits at REST API rates; listing styles is free. No plan tier named.
Napkin AI.note_en: Beta; sign in with your Napkin account. Each generated visual spends Napkin credits.
Napkin AI.note_de: Beta; Anmeldung mit Ihrem Napkin-Konto. Jede erzeugte Grafik verbraucht Napkin-Credits.

Litmaps.auth_note: Log in to Litmaps when prompted and click 'Allow'; protocol not named.
Litmaps.plan_note: Plan requirement not stated on the page.
Litmaps.note_en: Beta; add manually as a custom connector and log in to Litmaps. Reads and edits your maps.
Litmaps.note_de: Beta; manuell als eigener Connector hinzufügen und bei Litmaps anmelden. Liest und bearbeitet Ihre Maps.

scite.auth_note: OAuth 2.0, scope 'mcp'; endpoints under https://api.scite.ai/mcp/oauth/, discovered automatically by most clients.
scite.plan: Paid scite plan, free trial, or organisation Enterprise licence.
scite.source_note: Endpoint URL is only stated in scite.ai/llms.txt, not on the /mcp page itself.
scite.note_en: Sign in with your scite account via OAuth; needs a paid plan, a trial or an institutional licence.
scite.note_de: Anmeldung mit Ihrem scite-Konto per OAuth; erfordert Bezahltarif, Testphase oder institutionelle Lizenz.

Sally AI.auth_note: Leave OAuth fields empty; Sally sign-in runs on Connect.
Sally AI.plan: A Sally admin must enable MCP for the company account; in Claude, custom connectors need a paid Claude plan.
Sally AI.note_en: Read-only access to your own and shared meetings; a Sally admin must first enable MCP for the company.
Sally AI.note_de: Nur Lesezugriff auf eigene und geteilte Meetings; ein Sally-Admin muss MCP zuerst für das Unternehmen freischalten.

Otter.ai.transport_note: Not stated; configs give only a URL.
Otter.ai.auth_note: OAuth sign-in with your Otter account ('Authorize access').
Otter.ai.plan_note: Plan requirement not stated in the help article.
Otter.ai.note_en: Sign in with your Otter account via OAuth; searches and fetches your meeting transcripts.
Otter.ai.note_de: Anmeldung mit Ihrem Otter-Konto per OAuth; durchsucht und lädt Ihre Meeting-Transkripte.

Notion.transport_note: SSE fallback https://mcp.notion.com/sse only for clients without streamable HTTP.
Notion.auth_note: OAuth by default; Business/Enterprise workspace owners can create MCP tokens (Bearer) in the Developer portal.
Notion.local_note: This is the documented stdio bridge to the hosted server, not a local server. The open-source notion-mcp-server is 'no longer actively maintained'; no env var named.
Notion.cli: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
Notion.plan: Workspace members only (guests refused); MCP tokens and some features depend on plan.
Notion.note_en: Hosted server with OAuth sign-in; the old local server is no longer maintained, so use the hosted one.
Notion.note_de: Gehosteter Server mit OAuth-Anmeldung; der alte lokale Server wird nicht mehr gepflegt – nutzen Sie den gehosteten.

GitHub (repositories).auth_note: OAuth where the host supports it, otherwise a GitHub Personal Access Token as Bearer header.
GitHub (repositories).install: Docker installed and running (local variant); PAT from github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens
GitHub (repositories).plan_note: No paid plan stated; organisations may need to enable MCP policies.
GitHub (repositories).note_en: GitHub's official server: hosted with OAuth or token, or local via Docker. Organisation policies may need enabling.
GitHub (repositories).note_de: Offizieller GitHub-Server: gehostet mit OAuth oder Token oder lokal per Docker. Organisationsrichtlinien ggf. freischalten.

JASP.install: uv installed; JASP running with its remote RPC server enabled
JASP.note_en: Runs locally via uvx; JASP must be running with its remote RPC server enabled. Early stage.
JASP.note_de: Läuft lokal per uvx; JASP muss mit aktiviertem Remote-RPC-Server laufen. Frühes Entwicklungsstadium.

Zotero.auth_note: Local mode needs no key; writes on older Zotero need ZOTERO_API_KEY and ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID (web API).
Zotero.install: Python 3.10+; 'uv tool install zotero-mcp-server' (or pip); Zotero 7+ running with 'Allow other applications … to communicate with Zotero' enabled
Zotero.note_en: Install with uv, enable Zotero's local API; 'zotero-mcp setup' configures Claude Desktop automatically.
Zotero.note_de: Mit uv installieren, lokale Zotero-API aktivieren; 'zotero-mcp setup' richtet Claude Desktop automatisch ein.

EndNote.local_note: No JSON config is printed; 'endnote-mcp setup' writes the Claude Desktop config. Alternative: .mcpb bundle from Releases (no Python needed).
EndNote.install: EndNote 20+ with an XML export; Python 3.10+ and 'uv tool install endnote-mcp', then 'endnote-mcp setup'
EndNote.note_en: Works on an XML export of your library; easiest via the .mcpb bundle for Claude Desktop, no Python needed.
EndNote.note_de: Arbeitet mit einem XML-Export Ihrer Bibliothek; am einfachsten per .mcpb-Paket für Claude Desktop, ohne Python.

Mendeley.auth_note: Register an app at dev.mendeley.com/myapps.html (Client ID/Secret), then 'mendeley-auth login' stores tokens in the system keyring.
Mendeley.install: Python 3.10+ and 'uv tool install mendeley-mcp'; Mendeley account and own API app
Mendeley.note_en: Register your own Mendeley API app, then run 'mendeley-auth login' once; credentials stay in your keyring.
Mendeley.note_de: Eigene Mendeley-API-App registrieren, dann einmal 'mendeley-auth login' ausführen; Zugangsdaten bleiben im Schlüsselbund.

Google Scholar.local_note: README's macOS config 'python -m google_scholar_mcp_server' does not match the repo (only google_scholar_server.py exists); path variant taken from its Windows/Cline configs. Smithery: npx -y @smithery/cli@latest install @JackKuo666/google-scholar-mcp-server --client claude --config "{}".
Google Scholar.install: git clone the repo and 'pip install -r requirements.txt' (Python)
Google Scholar.note_en: Scrapes Google Scholar without an official API and may break; repo not updated since March 2025.
Google Scholar.note_de: Liest Google Scholar ohne offizielle API aus und kann ausfallen; Repository seit März 2025 nicht aktualisiert.

Whisper (OpenAI).install: Apple Silicon Mac, Python 3.12+ and uv; clone the repo (first run downloads ~1.6 GB model)
Whisper (OpenAI).note_en: Apple Silicon Macs only; audio stays on your machine. Not updated since June 2025.
Whisper (OpenAI).note_de: Nur für Macs mit Apple Silicon; Audio bleibt auf Ihrem Rechner. Seit Juni 2025 nicht aktualisiert.

Jamovi.local_note: Optional env JAMOVI_HOME only if jamovi is not found; README warns not to copy the placeholder.
Jamovi.install: Windows only; jamovi installed locally; uv (e.g. 'winget install astral-sh.uv')
Jamovi.note_en: Windows only – controls a local jamovi installation via uvx; check with 'jamovi-mcp --check'.
Jamovi.note_de: Nur Windows – steuert eine lokale jamovi-Installation per uvx; Prüfung mit 'jamovi-mcp --check'.

Obsidian.auth_note: API key from the Obsidian Local REST API plugin settings.
Obsidian.install: Python 3.11+ and uv; Obsidian with the Local REST API community plugin enabled
Obsidian.note_en: Needs the Obsidian Local REST API plugin and its API key; runs locally via uvx.
Obsidian.note_de: Erfordert das Obsidian-Plugin Local REST API und dessen API-Schlüssel; läuft lokal per uvx.

Transkribus.auth_note: Transkribus user name and password (OS keyring recommended, or env TRANSKRIBUS_USER / TRANSKRIBUS_PASSWORD).
Transkribus.local_note: Env block optional if credentials are stored in the OS keyring. 304 tools by default; split entry points exist for tool limits.
Transkribus.note_en: Runs locally via npx with your Transkribus login; over 300 tools, so use split servers if your client limits tools.
Transkribus.note_de: Läuft lokal per npx mit Ihrem Transkribus-Login; über 300 Tools – bei Tool-Limits geteilte Server nutzen.

Overleaf.auth_note: Overleaf Git token (Account Settings → Git Integration → Create Token) plus the project ID.
Overleaf.local_note: On Windows use command 'cmd' with args ['/c','npx','-y','@mjyoo2/overleaf-mcp'].
Overleaf.install: Node.js with npx; Overleaf project owner with paid subscription (Git integration)
Overleaf.plan: Git integration is a premium feature – project owner needs a paid Overleaf subscription (Overleaf docs).
Overleaf.note_en: Uses Overleaf's Git integration, a paid feature; the Git token grants full read and write access to the project.
Overleaf.note_de: Nutzt die Git-Integration von Overleaf (kostenpflichtig); das Git-Token gewährt vollen Lese- und Schreibzugriff auf das Projekt.

ars-deep-research.install: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills, then /plugin install academic-research-skills (installs all ARS skills). claude.ai/Desktop (paid): Customize → Plugins → Add marketplace → from repository.
ars-deep-research.note_en: Installed with the whole ARS plugin; the skills share repo-level files, so prefer the plugin to copying one folder.
ars-deep-research.note_de: Wird als Teil des ARS-Plugins installiert; die Skills teilen Dateien im Repo – Plugin statt Einzelordner verwenden.

ars-paper.install: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills, then /plugin install academic-research-skills (installs all ARS skills).
ars-paper.note_en: Part of the ARS plugin; also importable in Claude Science via Skills → Import from GitHub.
ars-paper.note_de: Teil des ARS-Plugins; in Claude Science auch über Skills → Import from GitHub importierbar.

ars-reviewer.install: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills, then /plugin install academic-research-skills (installs all ARS skills).
ars-reviewer.note_en: Part of the ARS plugin; one install provides the reviewer together with the other ARS skills.
ars-reviewer.note_de: Teil des ARS-Plugins; eine Installation liefert den Reviewer zusammen mit den übrigen ARS-Skills.

ars-screener.install: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills, then /plugin install academic-research-skills (installs all ARS skills).
ars-screener.note_en: Part of the ARS plugin; Codex users install the separate academic-research-skills-codex distribution.
ars-screener.note_de: Teil des ARS-Plugins; Codex-Nutzende installieren die separate Distribution academic-research-skills-codex.

kd-literature-review.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills literature-review (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-literature-review.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full 177-skill collection with npx skills add.
kd-literature-review.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung (177 Skills) per npx skills add.

kd-peer-review.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills peer-review (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-peer-review.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-peer-review.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-writing.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills scientific-writing (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-writing.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-writing.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-stats.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills statistical-analysis (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-stats.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-stats.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-power.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills statistical-power (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-power.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-power.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-hypothesis.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills hypothesis-generation (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-hypothesis.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-hypothesis.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-citation.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills citation-management (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-citation.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-citation.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-viz.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills scientific-visualization (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-viz.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-viz.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

kd-eda.install: gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills exploratory-data-analysis (GitHub CLI 2.90+), or whole collection: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
kd-eda.note_en: Install this single skill with gh skill, or the full collection with npx skills add.
kd-eda.note_de: Einzelnen Skill per gh skill installieren oder die gesamte Sammlung per npx skills add.

slr-prisma.install: Download slr-prisma.skill from the repo's Releases and add it in Claude under Customise → Skills; or copy SKILL.md and references/ into your skills folder (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/slr-prisma/).
slr-prisma.note_en: Upload the .skill file in Claude; the companion apa-referencing skill is recommended.
slr-prisma.note_de: Die .skill-Datei in Claude hochladen; der Begleit-Skill apa-referencing wird empfohlen.

prisma2020.install: install.packages("PRISMA2020") – or use the web app https://estech.shinyapps.io/prisma_flowdiagram/
prisma2020.install_note: README gives only Docker and the Shiny app; CRAN listing (v1.1.5) confirmed on cran.r-project.org/package=PRISMA2020.
prisma2020.note_en: R package on CRAN, or the point-and-click Shiny web app without any installation.
prisma2020.note_de: R-Paket auf CRAN oder die Shiny-Web-App zum Klicken ganz ohne Installation.

peer-review-panel.install: git clone https://github.com/AlexWortega/ai-peer-review-skill.git && ln -s "$(pwd)/ai-peer-review-skill" ~/.claude/skills/paper-review – then restart Claude Code
peer-review-panel.note_en: Claude Code skill; parallel reviewers come from one model family, not truly different models.
peer-review-panel.note_de: Claude-Code-Skill; die parallelen Gutachter stammen aus einer Modellfamilie, nicht aus verschiedenen Modellen.

seminr.note_en: CRAN package for PLS-SEM and CB-SEM; vignette("SEMinR") gives a guided introduction.
seminr.note_de: CRAN-Paket für PLS-SEM und CB-SEM; vignette("SEMinR") bietet eine geführte Einführung.

lavaan.note_en: Stable version from CRAN; development version via remotes::install_github("yrosseel/lavaan").
lavaan.note_de: Stabile Version von CRAN; Entwicklungsversion über remotes::install_github("yrosseel/lavaan").

metafor.note_en: Official CRAN release; development version via remotes::install_github("wviechtb/metafor").

truman.install: Self-hosted Node.js web app with a MongoDB database – follow 'Installing Truman' at https://truman.gitbook.io/the-truman-platform (uses the newer repo cornellsocialmedialab/truman_2023).
truman.outdated: cornellsml/truman README says the up-to-date code is at https://github.com/cornellsocialmedialab/truman_2023; old repo last pushed July 2024.
truman.note_en: Linked repo is superseded – use Truman 2.0 (truman_2023); needs Node.js, MongoDB and own hosting.
truman.note_de: Verlinktes Repo ist überholt – Truman 2.0 (truman_2023) nutzen; erfordert Node.js, MongoDB und eigenes Hosting.

mock-social-media.install: Self-hosted – follow the 'Deploying Locally' or 'Deploying Online' guides at docs.studysocial.media; code at https://github.com/arvinsroom/mocksocialmediawebsite (Apache-2.0).
mock-social-media.install_note: Concrete requirements are on the deployment subpages, not on the docs start page that was read.
mock-social-media.note_en: Self-hosted research tool; after deployment a researcher portal creates studies and exports data.
mock-social-media.note_de: Selbst gehostetes Forschungstool; nach der Einrichtung erstellt ein Forschendenportal Studien und exportiert Daten.

awesome-copilot.install: copilot plugin install <plugin-name>@awesome-copilot (if unknown: copilot plugin marketplace add github/awesome-copilot first)
awesome-copilot.note_en: Marketplace for GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code; entries come from third parties, so inspect before installing.
awesome-copilot.note_de: Marketplace für GitHub Copilot CLI und VS Code; Beiträge stammen von Dritten – vor der Installation prüfen.
